target.path_rule: template ids match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80} before any path join
target.database: no template row, table or migration

authority.service: re-reads the current User row, requires active status and TEAM_LEAD+, freezes status/is_active/role/raw tenant and claims that exact material in the AuditLog transaction
authority.scope: global workflow definitions; audit attributed to the acting user's real tenant/workspace
authority.path_traversal: unsafe template ids are not found

routes.effect: atomic exclusive create of one template JSON file plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.validation: route retains category/complexity 422 and step normalization
routes.collision: pre-existing file -> 409 TEMPLATE_EXISTS, peer file unchanged
routes.replay: same operation/material -> already_applied; changed -> 409; missing target -> committed_unverified

routes.effect: atomic replace of one template JSON file plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.validation: blocked mass-assignment fields and empty update 422 preserved
routes.cas: per-template lock, re-read immediately before write; any peer change -> 409 STALE_TARGET
routes.replay: same operation/material -> already_applied; changed -> 409; later revision -> committed_unverified

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id workflow-template:<create|update>:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw template name, description, steps, parameters, prompts, code, secret, SQL parameter or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target canonical payload digest must match

result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.routes: sole verified create/update writers for the template JSON files
parallel_writers.WorkflowTemplateManager.create_template: retained for internal/test callers; the route no longer uses it
parallel_writers.WorkflowTemplateManager.update_template: retained for internal/test callers; the route no longer uses it

not_covered: live workflow/agent execution, model or provider
